title: DCAD-2000: A Multilingual Dataset across 2000+ Languages with Data Cleaning as Anomaly Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating downstream model performance across languages categorized by resource availability (high, medium, low, and very low) using multilingual benchmarks such as SIB-200, Glot500-c, and FLORES-200 to measure performance disparities between high-resource and low-resource languages.
